jobgether-jobgether:lever:524c4638-4be3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Identify and document "last-mile" requirements needed to transform research outputs into stakeholder-ready deliverables and help drive improvements across the product. Contribute to the broader commercial and operational objectives of the research function, including customer retention, expansion, and conversion of new opportunities into recurring business. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9d67028d-a9d6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Crowd Artist based in Canada. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Crowd Artist to help bring large-scale film and television environments to life. You will create dynamic, believable crowds that add scale, energy, and realism to complex scenes. Working within a small and highly collaborative production team, you will combine artistic judgment with technical simulation expertise. The role involves setting up crowd assets, creating simulations, troubleshooting workflows, and delivering production-ready results. You will collaborate closely with FX, Look Development, Lighting, Animation, and CG leadership to ensure seamless integration. The position offers the chance to contribute to a major Marvel Studios streaming production while working in a supportive, creative environment. This is a fully remote opportunity across Canada, with the option to work from a Vancouver studio. Crowd simulation: Populate environments with characters and assets using crowd simulation techniques to create vibrant, believable scenes at scale. Asset setup: Prepare and configure digital crowd assets and develop Atoms simulations for more complex character behaviors and shot requirements. Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve simulation, setup, and workflow issues while testing new approaches to maintain production efficiency and quality. Creative integration: Work closely with FX, Look Development, Lighting, Animation, and CG Supervisors to ensure crowd elements align with the visual direction of each sequence. Cross-functional collaboration: Communicate proactively with other departments regarding creative solutions, workflow improvements, technical requirements, and production handoffs. Production delivery: Manage assigned tasks and deadlines effectively, provide regular progress updates, and consistently deliver high-quality work within production schedules. Workflow improvement: Contribute ideas and practical solutions that improve crowd creation, simulation, and integration workflows across the production. Requirements: Professional experience: 2+ years of experience working on feature films, episodic television, or animated features, with a strong focus on crowd work. Crowd simulation expertise: Hands-on experience creating digital crowd assets and running complex simulations using Atoms . Artistic and technical ability: Strong understanding of crowd movement and behavior, combined with a strong artistic eye and the ability to balance visual quality with technical requirements. Problem-solving: Ability to investigate technical challenges, experiment with workflows, and develop practical solutions independently. Collaboration: Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple CG and production departments. Production awareness: Strong time-management skills and the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and communicate proactively about progress or challenges. Work authorization: Must be legally eligible to work in Canada. Linux: Familiarity with Linux-based operating systems is an asset. Crowd workflows: Experience with background crowd simulation methods and production workflows is an asset. Production tracking: Working knowledge of Flow Production Tracking, formerly ShotGrid, is an asset. Additional software: Experience with other crowd tools such as Houdini or Golaem is considered an advantage. Portfolio: A professional portfolio or demo reel demonstrating relevant crowd and simulation work is expected. Availability: Ability to start within the required production window of late October to mid-November 2026. Benefits: Competitive compensation: CAD $83,000–$92,000 annually, depending on experience and level. Remote flexibility: Fully remote position available anywhere in Canada. Vancouver option: Access to a Vancouver studio for those who prefer working

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:7e10697a-8932-4be6.title: Growth Product Manager
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:7e10697a-8932-4be6.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми шукаємо Growth Product Manager, щоб разом підіймати планку результату. У цій ролі ви станете драйвером нашого власного платіжного рішення: будете знаходити інсайти на основі даних, визначати пріоритети та бачити як ваші ідеї масштабують продукт і трансформуються у конкретний фінансовий результат. Якщо вам цікаво власноруч формувати стратегію розвитку продукту, впливати на бізнес-показники та працювати у тісній зв’язці з продуктовою командою — ця позиція саме для вас. Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі: - Масштабування зрілого продукту: Працювати з беклогом після стадії MVP. Майстерно поєднувати Growth-експерименти та усунення критичних блокерів масштабування, без втрати темпу розвитку - Ownership у зоні невизначеності: У нас немає готових інструкцій. Ви самостійно визначаєте вектор руху, ініціюєте проєкти та несете відповідальність за результат — від ідеї до впливу на бізнес-показники - Захист логіки: Обґрунтовувати ініціативи через реальну цінність для бізнесу, глибокий аналіз та критичне мислення - Прийняття рішень у конфліктуючих умовах: Впевнено обирати, над чим команда працюватиме наступні квартали, навіть коли контексти та пріоритети конфліктують - Автономність та драйв: Бути самостійною одиницею, яка сама драйвить процеси та людей навколо Що для нас важливо: - 4+ років досвіду в ролі Product Manager/Growth Product Manager або аналогічній (IT) - Досвід впливу на ключові бізнес-метрики: Наявність у портфоліо кейсів, де ваші рішення безпосередньо впливали на P&L або Growth-показники компанії - Досвід зі зрілими продуктами: Розуміння, як розвивати продукт після стадії MVP - Топ-рівень навички пріоритезації. Глибоке розуміння цінності кожної задачі. Ви будуєте беклог не за шаблонами, а виходячи з реальних потреб бізнесу та користувачів - Data-driven підхід: Ви вільно оперуєте даними, розумієте логіку когортного аналізу, використовуєте аналітику як інструмент для прийняття рішень Буде перевагою: - Product Growth Background: Досвід роботи в Growth-командах або на етапах інтенсивного масштабування продукту - Досвід роботи в домені платежів У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. - Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Position Highlights Team Lead Leadership Stipend Highly competitive compensation No call - No nights - No weekends - No holidays Flexible scheduling Independent CRNA practice model High degree of autonomy 7 am First Case Full-time and PRN Needs - W2 and 1099 options 4 Rooms What You'll Do Provide anesthesia care for outpatient GI procedures Conduct pre-anesthesia evaluations and patient assessments Manage airway and anesthesia administration Monitor patients throughout procedures and recovery Collaborate with physicians, nurses, and support staff Maintain compliance with clinical and safety standards What We Offer Comprehensive benefits package Stable, respected practice Supportive team culture Strong operational support through GI Alliance Qualifications CRNA Eligible state license Excellent communication skills The Specialty Alliance - Powering the future of physician-led, multi-specialty care. Uniting and empowering the nation’s leading physician-led gastroenterology and urology practices through an exclusive alliance built for clinical excellence, growth, and exceptional patient care. Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources. Our partnership model preserves clinical autonomy while enabling responsible growth and high-quality specialty care nationwide. To learn more about The Specialty Alliance, visit www.thespecialtyalliance.com . weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:7b869061-085.title: Project Lyra Swedish Culture Expert
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:7b869061-085.description: Overview Are you passionate about languages, writing, and quality evaluation? We are launching an exciting language evaluation project and are looking for Swedish-speaking experts to join our team. In this role, you will contribute to training AI systems to better understand, generate, and refine language by performing structured evaluation and writing tasks, all from the comfort of your home and on a flexible schedule. What you will do: - Evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, grammar, and cultural relevance. - Identify issues and provide refined, high-quality rewritten responses. - Create natural prompts and responses in Swedish to improve conversational datasets. - Collaborate with global teams to help improve AI language models. Project Details: - Start Date: Coming soon. - Duration: 4 weeks. - Rate : $39.6 USD/hour - Commitment: ~20 hours/week (flexible schedule). - Job Type: Freelance contract. - Location: Remote. Requirements: - Background as a teacher (preferred but not a must) or experience in teaching/writing in Swedish. - Excellent written communication and strong grammatical accuracy. - Familiarity with cultural nuances in Swedish. - Comfortable with structured tasks such as: preference ranking (factuality & locality), prompt-response writing, grammaticality checks, provision & improvement of text. Note: Please do not use VPNs or IP-masking tools during the recruitment process — our security system requires accurate regional verification.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:e7034076-e17.title: Project Manager
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:e7034076-e17.description: About Welo Life Sciences Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com MAIN PURPOSE OF JOB The Project Manager is responsible for ensuring the successful planning, execution, tracking, delivery and closure of client projects. The Project Manager works with the client to understand requirements and engages the global team in the fulfilment of these requirements, crafting client solutions based on the Welocalize Four Pillars of Customer Service, Quality, Innovation and Global Teamwork. The ideal candidate is a driven but steady individual, capable of building relationships across the entire project team, with the flexibility and energy to thrive in a dynamic environment. MAIN DUTIES The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership of the Project Manager: Project planning, scoping, requirements gathering and validation with client. Identifying and working with the relevant client and internal stakeholders to plan and resource projects appropriately in terms of quality, cost, and schedule requirements. Risk analysis and contingency planning (plan-do-check-act cycle). Leading the internal and external team to successful execution and delivery of client projects Creating schedule and monitoring timeliness of delivery. Managing the budget and controlling project costs. Establishing and nurturing relationships with the customer, internal teams and external suppliers. Overseeing project activities and ensuring resolution to any problems that may arise (corrective and preventive action). Actively seeking ways to optimize delivery, client satisfaction, quality and profitability. Reporting, both in written and verbal form, to internal and external stakeholders regarding Project scope, financials, progress and status, formally and on an ad-hoc basis as required. Ensuring finance systems are kept up to date and accurate. Process documentation and knowledge management. Ensuring profit of project is maintained through the management of margin. Measures of success Delivery of services in line with core KPIs for project management, which include but are not limited to: client satisfaction; on-time delivery; cost control and profitability; revenue throughput; Client growth. REQUIREMENTS Education Level Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) from a college or university in related filed. Experience Proven project management experience in a fast-paced, client-centric environment, ideally in the translation or localization industry. Knowledge of the translation industry and a keen interest in its technology, process, competitive landscape and emerging trends. Demonstrated success at managing large accounts and/or projects. Curiosity and creativity to question existing processes and approaches and innovate new ones. Proven experience in development of processes and ideas. Experience in financial management and budget to actual management. Customer relationship management and business development skills to drive organic growth. Must be available to travel for work related commitments Other relevant skills Energy and a positive attitude with excellent interpersonal
